ranked_findings.title: Guardrail bypass caused duplicate refunds
ranked_findings.description: The idempotency-required guardrail was skipped due to legacy_batch_header, allowing bulk-refund requests without idempotency keys to be processed
evidence: corpus/timeline/incident_timeline.md: idempotency-required guardrail skipped due to legacy_batch_header
corpus/tickets/TICKET-8729.md: every duplicate has request_class=bulk-refund and no idempotency key

ranked_findings.title: Bulk-refund requests accepted without idempotency keys
ranked_findings.description: At 10:17 UTC, bulk-refund requests were accepted with missing idempotency keys
evidence: corpus/timeline/incident_timeline.md: bulk refund requests accepted without idempotency keys

ranked_findings.title: Duplicate refunds affected enterprise accounts
ranked_findings.description: Three enterprise accounts received duplicate refunds
evidence: corpus/tickets/TICKET-8721.md: duplicate refunds observed for three enterprise accounts

unresolved_ambiguity.description: Initial theory of queue worker replay vs. actual cause (missing idempotency validation)
unresolved_ambiguity.initial_theory: Queue worker replayed old payment event after timeout
unresolved_ambiguity.clarified_cause: Missing idempotency key validation due to guardrail bypass

triggering_condition.description: Bulk-refund requests accepted without idempotency keys

actions: Reject bulk-refund requests without idempotency key
Remove legacy_batch_header bypass before re-enabling endpoint
